name: peace lily
fact: not a real lily at all. it droops dramatically when thirsty, then perks right back up after a drink.
care: water about once a week, bright indirect light, dust its leaves now and then.

name: calathea
fact: also called the peacock plant. its leaves fold up at night and open again in the morning.
care: keep the soil lightly moist, use filtered water, keep it humid and out of direct sun.

name: silvery ann
fact: not a real pothos, even though everyone calls it one. the silver spots are tiny air pockets that catch the light.
care: let the soil dry out between drinks, medium light. curling leaves mean it is thirsty.
